description.value: The Lung Duck Tong Restaurant is a long-standing local favourite situated within Barkerville Historic Town & Park, the largest living history museum in western North America. Renowned for fresh, authentic Chinese cooking, it draws visitors from around the world to this remote gold-rush heritage town deep in the Cariboo. For touring cyclists making the journey up Highway 26, it offers a distinctive dining experience unlike anything else along the route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content from barkerville.ca/merchants/ directly confirms Lung Duck Tong Restaurant as an active independent merchant at Barkerville Historic Town & Park (Building #81), operating seasonally in 2026 with a main season phone number of 250-994-3458. The OSM record had no address, phone, or website tags — all contact details come from the website. No bike-specific amenities, washroom references, or takeout/water details are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content.
concerns: The website URL is the parent Barkerville Historic Town & Park merchants page, not a dedicated restaurant website; no restaurant-specific standalone site found.
OSM had no phone, address, or website tags — all contact details sourced from the discovered website only, so contact_confirmed fields are all null.
An off-season phone number (204-899-5345) with a Manitoba area code is listed on the website; this may reflect the operator's home province and is worth noting for directory accuracy.
The restaurant is only open seasonally (approximately mid-May to mid-September); the listing is inactive outside that window.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating restaurant confirmed active for the 2026 season within a major heritage tourism destination; clearly accessible to the public and useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Building #81 within Barkerville Historic Town & Park. Accepts Visa, MC & Debit. A menu link is available on the parent merchants page.
